answer: Neighbor-quorum bond: each identity claims a grove plot, locks 70 credits, and needs five neighbors from five grove plots to co-sign its river entry in one epoch. The public mirror lets auditors replay quorums and expose a rented-neighbor ring. Endorsing a fake burns the endorser's bond; three fakes expel them. First identity costs 120, the k-th 120+12(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 6,114,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 120 once.
